subject: Why would shiny server pro use a packrat-enabled lib but not community edition?

messages.author: c1f498d9cb6627e8
messages.subject: Why would shiny server pro use a packrat-enabled lib but not community edition?
parts:
Hi,

I posted this on git as an issue & now that I read the documentation I realize I probably should have posted here first.

I'll put the short version here (apologies for cross-posting) with a link to a more comprehensive version: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/issues/143

Short version is, shiny server pro has been correctly using packages from local packrat libs, while shiny server community edition does not. 

Is this expected behavior?
